title: Expand workflow evaluations to the founder jobs
baseline_ref: brief/q-01; stacked because Q-02 extends the same evaluator files

status.capability_ready: evaluation fixtures and tooling only; no product capability or flag
status.publication: PR #734 open against brief/q-01 (stacked on Q-01 #725); https://github.com/vierisid/jarvis/pull/734

design.checkpoint: UI-35; no visual changes in Q-02

ownership.independent_reviewer: pending; Lapo coordinates technical review and shared-file integration

behavior: founder task set: 16 development and 66 held-out tasks (44 supported, 22 to refuse) across meeting, invoice, lead and recurring-report jobs; held-out reference answers kept outside the repository.
Sealed reserve of 36 tasks outside the repository; tasks/founder-reserve-1.commitment.json pins its hash and a mismatching file is refused.

founder-v1 environment: context, tool and agent pieces; the seven bounded workflow tools from their real definitions; three machines, one offline; Gmail and Slack metadata graded on the graph, never executed. w8 unchanged.

Fake services answer from each scenario's sandbox: approval creates a real waitpoint and pauses the run; an offline machine blocks; a missing file errors; memory search matches entity names as production does.

Assertions: exact notifications, tool calls (tool, parameters, outcome) and agent delegations; expected run status; AI prompt inclusions and exclusions; structured forbidden constraints; connection-bound steps by action, connection and literal inputs.
--mode review-packet writes a blinded, shuffled packet and a separate key; reviews record usefulness and AI fidelity, reported apart from intent.
--mode smoke --references FILE proves a held-out or reserve set satisfiable without publishing answers; it measures nothing.

acceptance.check: Incorrect recipients, missing steps, invented facts, extra effects and unnecessary AI all fail explicit assertions
acceptance.evidence: src/workflows/evaluation/founder-tasks.test.ts (scenario assertions, AI fidelity, connection-bound steps, forbidden constraints, unexpected effects); evidence/Q-02/revert-checks.log

acceptance.check: Review rubric records edits and time rather than treating automatic success as zero correction
acceptance.evidence: Blind review template requires reviewer, intent, time and edits per row and adds usefulness and fidelity; founder-tasks.test.ts blinded review test

verification.result: 7,761 pass, 86 skip, 9 fail of 7,856 tests across 425 files (local WSL2). migration: None. No schema, data or production behavior change.
rollback: Revert the Q-02 commit. Older run directories remain readable.
limitations: The workflow's own AI and agent replies are simulated; summary quality of the runtime model is left to blinded review.
Connection-bound integrations are never executed; they are graded on the composed graph with literal inputs.
Sandboxed tools return fixture data, not a real machine's.
No hosted model was run; Q-01's gates still apply to any paid run of the founder set.
found: A router 'starts with' condition cannot be expressed correctly: the engine implements TEXT_START_WITH, readiness accepts only TEXT_STARTS_WITH, and the engine's condition evaluation passes any unknown operator. Not changed here; the held-out set includes a task that catches it.
